description.en: Returns the current "draw off" bitmask: a set of bit flags where each set bit disables rendering of a corresponding scene layer/element. Read together with CMND_GET_PAUSE_BIT and written back with CMND_SET_DRAW_OFF_BIT to temporarily hide parts of the scene (e.g. while showing a full-screen menu).

example.code:
// Read the current draw-off bits before toggling one off
local now_bit_draw = CMND_GET_DRAW_OFF_BIT();
